title: Google Scholar Intelligence Input
description: Search Google Scholar at scale. Pass queries, author profile URLs, cluster IDs, or paper IDs. Each paper ships as one row with optional author affiliations, citing papers, and BibTeX.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Free text queries. Supports Scholar operators: "exact phrase", author:Hinton, intitle:transformer. Example: ["large language model", "author:LeCun convolutional"].
queries.sectionDescription: Provide at least one of: queries, authorUrls, clusterIds, or paperUrls.

authorUrls.title: Author profile URLs
authorUrls.description: Google Scholar citations profile URLs. Example: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=JicYPdAAAAAJ. Returns the author's full publication list.

clusterIds.title: Cluster IDs
clusterIds.description: Scholar cluster IDs to fetch all versions of one paper, or its citing papers. Example: 17784817748666649498.

paperUrls.title: Direct paper URLs
paperUrls.description: Scholar result URLs to enrich with full metadata (BibTeX, citing papers, related). Useful when you already have a list of papers and need citations.

yearFrom.title: Published from year
yearFrom.description: Lower bound on publication year. 0 means no lower bound.
yearFrom.sectionDescription: All filters apply to query searches. Author profile and cluster fetches return everything.

yearTo.title: Published until year
yearTo.description: Upper bound on publication year. 0 means no upper bound.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: Relevance is Scholar's default. Date sorts newest first.

language.title: Language
language.description: Scholar interface language. Affects venue parsing and citation labels.

includePatents.title: Include patents
includePatents.description: Include patent results. Off by default to keep results to peer reviewed papers.

includeCaseLaw.title: Include case law
includeCaseLaw.description: Include legal case law results. Off by default.

fetchAuthorProfiles.title: Enrich with author profiles
fetchAuthorProfiles.description: For every paper with at least one author profile linked, fetch the author's affiliation, h-index, i10-index, and total citations. Adds one extra request per unique author.
fetchAuthorProfiles.sectionDescription: Each enrichment toggle adds requests per paper. Use with maxPapers to bound cost.

fetchCitedBy.title: Fetch citing papers
fetchCitedBy.description: For papers with N or more citations, fetch the list of papers that cite this work. Adds citingPapers[] to the row.

minCitationsForCitedBy.title: Minimum citations to fetch cited by
minCitationsForCitedBy.description: Only fetch citing papers when the paper has at least this many citations. Avoids wasting requests on low cited papers.

maxCitedByPapers.title: Max citing papers per source paper
maxCitedByPapers.description: Cap on how many citing papers to fetch per source paper. Scholar returns 10 per page.

fetchBibtex.title: Fetch BibTeX
fetchBibtex.description: Pull the BibTeX export for every paper. Adds bibtex (string) to the row. Adds one extra request per paper.

fetchVersions.title: Fetch all versions
fetchVersions.description: For each paper, fetch every Scholar cluster version (preprint, published, repository copies). Adds versions[] to the row.

maxPapers.title: Total maximum papers
maxPapers.description: Hard cap on paper rows pushed per run. 0 means unlimited (Scholar caps at ~1000 results per query).

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Pages of 10 results to walk per query. Scholar caps at 100 pages (1000 results) per query and aggressively rate limits past page 30.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip cluster IDs already pushed in previous runs. Keyed on Scholar cluster ID. Turn off to refresh stale rows.

navigationDelayMs.title: Delay between navigations (ms)
navigationDelayMs.description: Pause between page loads. Scholar throttles fast scraping. 4000 to 8000 ms is the safe range.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel browser pages. Keep at 1 to 2 unless you have a residential proxy pool.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Scholar aggressively blocks datacenter IPs. RESIDENTIAL strongly recommended.
